source: DESP 320 BOM.pdf (GA drawing BOM, 'Common for Large & Small Unit') + QCP DESPL 320SR01-09.pdf weld-joint references, cross-checked against seed/component-routes.json's 25 canonical routes and seed/qcp-templates.json's 62-item checkpoint list. Compiled 25 Aug 2026.
note: Not yet wired into any seed script — DESPL-320 was originally seeded (scripts/seed-despl320-and-de0467.ts) from the QCP document header only (Job + 36-process spine + 9 Units + QCP template). No BomItem or Component/ComponentOperation rows exist for this job yet, unlike DE0463/DE0467 which came from a live-jobs.json CSV export. This file is that missing input, in a shape a new ingestion block can consume the same way DE0467's block reads live-jobs.json: for each unit (320SR01..320SR09), for each entry below, create one BomItem (equipmentId = the DESPL-320 Equipment row) + one Component (unitId = that unit, tag = `${entry.tag}` per unit, componentTypeId resolved via entry.componentType, routeVersionId resolved via componentTypeIdByCode -> RouteTemplateVersion) + ComponentOperation rows seeded NOT_STARTED from that route's steps, exactly like the DE0467 block already does (scripts/seed-despl320-and-de0467.ts ~line 556). CORRECTS a count error in docs/DESPL-320-DEV-READY-BOM-SCHEDULE-v1.md §4.4: that doc says '10 trackable components per unit' but then lists Shell + Top Dished End + Bottom Dished End + Skirt + 7 nozzle connections (M1, N1-N6) = 11, not 10. This file uses the correct 11, so 11 x 9 units = 99 Component rows, not 90.
weldJointNote: weldJoints listed per component are the printed joint-map references (LS-1/CS-1/CS-2) for cross-linking after WeldJoint rows are created — WeldJoint is NOT pre-seeded anywhere in this codebase for any job; it is real shop-floor data entered live through the app as welding happens (per the app's own model), so no WeldJoint seed is included here on purpose.
